decisions.reason: It remains closely tied to the firm's core authentication and secure communication capabilities, so in a growing market management would usually retain it unless several years of results clearly fell below aspiration levels.

Because it supports the firm's move into mobile interactions and digital signing, boundedly rational management is likely to keep it, though the risk of withdrawal is moderate if demand as a standalone offer has stayed weak.
This product is most deeply anchored in the firm's core security architecture and platform logic, so even with uncertain recent visibility it is the least likely to be dropped.

As a more niche extension with weaker strategic centrality, several years without clear visible traction would push management to reallocate its resources to the established business and new development.
